Rome, Georgia 30165

AmbDescription:
Join us at the GE Trails to run as much or as little as you like. 
Just interested? Feel free to come with no dog or whatever kind of set up you're currently using.
Interested in gear? Show up a little before 8 and you can use our kit bag to try on different things and borrow something for the run.
There are loops here every distance from 1 mile to 13 miles. You can't get lost here, so feel free to take off at your own pace for whatever your team needs. I'll be bringing up the rear at whatever pace that is, so don't worry about getting dropped. Bring water! The lot has zero shade, so if you're switching out dogs check temperatures and bring fans/shades as needed. If there has been heavy rain, we'll alter location to protect the trails. Check out the facebook event link to ask questions or get updates!

All breeds and speeds welcome!

AmbDescription:
If you are new to running canicross or never ran before, this will be a good starter night.  These trails are very easy and great to help you get your feet comfortable.  ALL abilities are highly encouraged to join!  Canicross is for everyone and all sized dogs!

Don’t have any gear?  Don’t fret as I have a lot of options with me for you to try out and see what works.

State park pass is required.  Bathrooms and picnic areas available.  Water sources for humans and dogs on site, but I will also bring some. 

I’m planning to be there by 5:40 pm to help with any gear or harness fitting questions. 

If you have any questions, please reach out and send me a message!  This will be a fun, low key run aimed at newbies, both human and canine!  Let’s “Hook Up and Chase Tail”!

Do you have any questions about North American Canicross and their titling program?  Don’t be shy, I’m here to help!

Somers, New York 10589
United States
AmbDescription: Join Hendrick and I for a canicross run to Celebrate his 3rd birthday! This is one of the flattest, potentially fastest, and (arguably) most scenic 5K trail runs in Westchester. We're talking a whopping 94 feet of ascent over the duration with a lot of single track and technical bits that include dirt, mud, sand, and rock surfaces, with just enough root to keep one super focused. This is an out and back run and we will keep the pace appropriate to whomever shows to work on running with other canicrossers and overtaking/directional commands. The trail head parking lot is small, additional parking is available on the shoulder of the road. No admission or parking fees. Interested, though don't want to run with your dog yet, or are hoping to have a dog soon, feel free to show up and say hello or even better run along without a dog.

Cross River, New York 10576

AmbDescription: Join Hendrick and I for a 5K canicross trail run in beautiful Ward Pound Ridge Reservation. We will meet in the northwest corner of the Meadows Parking Lot. The run will be over varied terrain including grass, dirt, mud, some item 4, roots, rocks, and wooden bridges with moderate elevation change (for Westchester) on trials roughly following the Cross River upstream to the Kimberly Bridge parking area and then back, mix of wide and single track trails. Pace will be set to keep the group together and work on overtaking skills. The aim is to have fun, learn, and build the community not drop people. Remember the reservation does charge a daily access fee, see their website for particulars.
